periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, angled approximately 45 degrees downward toward the muzzle relative to the horizontal facial axis.

periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering toward the lower margin, shifting the visual mass below the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow, broad U-shaped curve along the posterior edge of the transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Substantial thickness, comprising approximately 30-35% of the visible dorsal torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation, roughly equivalent to 2.5 times the width of a single ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Regular, smooth semicircular curvature at the superior boundaries.
